category_title: Toddlers engaging in physical aggression or object-related peer conflicts
scenario_title: Conflict over limited resources during mealtime or structured activity
minimal_context: The student is standing in a queue with peers to receive a treat during mealtime.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is mealtime now. Please stand in the queue to get your treat.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Runs to the front of the queue, pushing past another child to reach the treats first) Mine!

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs the treat directly out of the other child's hand) I want it!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to share with our friends.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hits the other child who tries to take the treat back, holding onto the treat tightly and yelling) No! My treat!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is mealtime now. Please stand in the queue to get your treat.

STUDENT: (Runs to the front of the queue, pushing past another child to reach the treats first) Mine!

TUTOR: Please wait in the line.

STUDENT: (Grabs the treat directly out of the other child's hand) I want it!

TUTOR: We need to share with our friends.

STUDENT: (Hits the other child who tries to take the treat back, holding onto the treat tightly and yelling) No! My treat!

task.content: Interacting during mealtime and structured activity

context.environment: Italian nurseries during mealtime and structured activity
context.materials: a treat, a place in a queue

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: competition for limited resources, such as contests over a treat, a place in a queue

behavior_patterns.condition: When the conflict includes aggressive behaviour
